title: High Dose STZ Induction Protocol
author: Frank Brosius
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8iyhufw
materials: Prepare the buffers and solutions as described below. Please note that the STZ- Na-Citrate solution should be prepared immediately prior to injection so as to avoid degradation of the STZ.
Each mouse should be given one injection.

steps.title: Fast mice before injection
steps.instruction: Fast each mouse for four hours prior to the STZ injection.

steps.title: Anesthetize mouse with isoflurane
steps.instruction: Place one mouse in an isoflurane drop jar following local IACUC anesthesia standards and wait until breathing slows and the animal is fully anesthetized.

steps.title: Inject STZ solution IP
steps.instruction: Inject the appropriate volume of STZ solution intraperitoneally so that the final dose equals 150 mg per kilogram of mouse body weight.

steps.title: Allow mouse to recover
steps.instruction: Allow the mouse to awaken from anesthesia and return it to its cage.

steps.title: Provide sucrose water overnight
steps.instruction: Supply the mouse with 10 % sucrose water overnight to prevent sudden hypoglycemia after injection.

steps.title: Monitor hyperglycemia
steps.instruction: Test each mouse for hyperglycemia two days after injection and again four weeks post‑injection; confirm that the mouse is severely diabetic.

steps.title: Repeat for each mouse
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire procedure for each animal, re‑loading the isoflurane source after every third or fourth mouse to maintain proper anesthesia.
